name: Seed of the Dead: Sweet Home
summary: TeamKRAMA's wild 3D third/first-person zombie survival shooter pairing legitimate co-op-style AI companions & base upgrades.
ranking_rationale: Surprising genuine arcade zombie-shooting fun alongside full base-building companion routes (trade-off: b-movie arcade gunplay lacks AAA polish).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
